title: City Utilities crews repairing sinkholes across Laredo after rain — drivers urged to slow down
excerpt: Laredo Utilities crews are making temporary repairs to sinkholes reported across the city after recent rain, and drivers are urged to slow down near work zones.
content:
City of Laredo Utilities crews are repairing sinkholes reported across Laredo after recent rain, the Utilities Department announced Monday, November 9.

The department said it has received multiple reports of sinkholes throughout the city, and the repairs now underway are temporary fixes due to the rain. Crews are working as quickly and safely as possible to address the areas and make roadways safe for motorists.

Drivers are urged to use caution: slow down near work zones, follow posted warning signs, and be mindful of crews working on the repairs.

Source: City of Laredo Utilities Department (Facebook, Nov. 9, 2026).
